subject: More ASan build improvements (#102)
reason: The change modifies only build tooling: build.sh (clearer output messages and continuing past unit-test failures in ASan runs), a CMake refactor extracting the unchanged ASan compile flags into a helper function, and applying those flags to the test-only testing_common static library. No runtime code of the valkey-search module is touched, so the module's commands, indexing, persistence and replication behaviour are identical between the parent and the change; there is nothing a scenario could exercise or compare.
